body:
Residual of #698 (`fix/698-kinship-affinity`); red-team r1 verified the counts.

- **Where.** GhanaLSS 1991-92 (1,211) and 1998-99 (1,766).
- **The defect.** The wave decode tables (`GhanaLSS/1991-92/_/categorical_mapping.org`, `1998-99/_/…`) map code 6 to `Other relative`. Under the 2026-09-07 rule, a "relative of head OR SPOUSE" label is `[null, null, null]`.
- **The fix.** A distinct decoded label, plus harmonization-table and kinship rows. This interacts with the Comparable view, where GLSS3+ `Other relative` absorbs siblings.
- **Cost.** Wave `.org` edits move those waves' hashes and every GhanaLSS L2-country hash.
title: GhanaLSS GLSS3/4 code 6 'Relative of head or head's spouse' is served [null, null, consanguineal] (2,977 people)
